research_rationale: EO 9447 (June 8, 1944; 9 FR 6293) is an amendment-only order: it rewrites subsections A1(b), A2(b), A3(b), B1 and B6 of EO 9356 of June 24, 1943 (regulations on clothing in kind or cash allowances for enlisted Navy and Coast Guard personnel), effective July 1, 1944. The held Federal Register original was read in full. Three of the subsections are fiscal-year-1945 rate rows that ended by their own terms on June 30, 1945; the other two (B1 payment timing and B6 credit rule) are continuing rules that lived inside EO 9356 until EO 9744B (signed June 29, 1946; 11 FR 7391) superseded EO 9356, EO 9447 and the other listed amending orders and prescribed fresh regulations for the fiscal year 1947. The Federal Register catalog and the 1989 codification both record the amendment of EO 9356 and the supersession by EO 9744-B. The held later amendments of EO 9356 (EO 9525, EO 9642 and the other orders listed in EO 9744B) do not revive or extend EO 9447. The recommended provisional status is no.
savings_reason: The order's rules governed cash and in-kind clothing allowances for enlisted personnel in fiscal years 1944 to 1946. EO 9744B supersedes EO 9447 by name and replaces its subject matter with new regulations for fiscal year 1947 onward, so no allowance payable under the rewritten subsections was left governed by EO 9447 after the supersession, and no later held instrument saves or revives it. The held sources show no accrued right or liability that the order alone preserves, and the bounded U.S. Code, eCFR and Federal Register catalog searches found no later instrument naming it.
earlier_end_check: Earlier ends were tested subsection by subsection. The three rate rows end earlier than the supersession by their own fiscal-year-1945 wording (June 30, 1945). For B1 and B6 the held texts of the later orders that amend EO 9356 (EO 9465 amends A6(b); EO 9525 adds A9; EO 9642 restates the fiscal-year-1946 rate rows) contain no reference to B1 or B6, so no earlier amendment, supersession or revocation of those two subsections is shown before EO 9744B.
scope_check: Five clauses, one for each subsection rewritten by the order (A1(b), A2(b), A3(b), B1, B6), covering the whole operative text of the held Federal Register original (9 FR 6293) including its effective-date sentence; the dossier's single whole clause is corrected by inventory slices of that original.
independent_command_check: The order has no independent command beyond the rewritten text: no delegation, report or duration of its own. The rewritten subsections are regulations that live inside EO 9356; they are not separate commands of EO 9447 once the amendment took effect on July 1, 1944.
savings_check: Savings considered and none found. EO 9744B supersedes EO 9447 without a saving clause for it, and its only retroactive provision (subsection A10) concerns a different subject; the catalog and codification observations record only the amendment of EO 9356 and the supersession by EO 9744-B.

research_rationale: EO 12701 (February 14, 1990; 55 FR 5953) is a one-paragraph amending order. Its single operative command orders that the second sentence of section 1 of EO 12334 (the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board order of December 4, 1981) be deleted and a new sentence inserted in its place, so that one member is designated by the President as Chairman. The held Federal Register original is read in full: there is no other clause, no duration, no report duty and no delegation. The command is self-executing and was performed when the order issued on 1990-02-14; under the owner's amendment rulings the inserted sentence then lived inside EO 12334 until that order ended. EO 12863 of September 13, 1993 (58 FR 48441, section 3.3) revoked EO 12334 as amended, which ended the surviving sentence. Nothing in the held sources shows any later order, statute or regulation restoring EO 12334 or re-adopting the amended sentence. The recommended provisional status is no.
savings_reason: The only consequence of the order was the replacement sentence about the Chairman inside EO 12334. Section 3.3 of EO 12863 of September 13, 1993 (held as the American Presidency Project transcription of the order; the Federal Register page 58 FR 48441 is also held as a text layer) revokes EO 12334 as amended, so that consequence ended on 1993-09-13 with its parent. No residual right, appointment, transfer or continuing duty arose from EO 12701 itself, and the bounded searches of the U.S. Code, the eCFR and the Office of the Federal Register disposition catalog found no later instrument that revives it.
earlier_end_check: No instrument earlier than EO 12863 touches this order: the Federal Register catalog observation for EO 12701 records only that it amends EO 12334, and the held-text search for the number 12701 finds only the order's own printing. The order's own command was complete on issue (1990-02-14), which is the first end of the order itself; the inserted sentence survived in EO 12334 until the parent was revoked on 1993-09-13.
scope_check: One clause only, the sole paragraph, which amends section 1 of EO 12334 and nothing else. The original is a single Federal Register page (55 FR 5953), complete in the held text; there is no section, proviso or partial scope to separate.
independent_command_check: There is no independent continuing command: the order contains no report deadline, no standing delegation and no duration. Its one command, to replace a sentence of EO 12334, was exhausted when the order issued. The replacement sentence is not a command of EO 12701 and it ended with EO 12334 on 1993-09-13.
savings_check: Savings considered and none found: the amendment concerns only who chairs a federal advisory board that was itself abolished by revoking EO 12334, so no appointment, right or liability depends on EO 12701 after 1993.

research_rationale: EO 11943 (October 25, 1976; 41 FR 47213) is a one-paragraph order that corrects a typographical error in Schedule 3 of EO 11941 of October 1, 1976: it amends the adjusted maximum scale of pay in the Section 4103 Schedule for Director of Nursing Service by changing one figure. The held Federal Register original is read in full and has no other clause. The correction was made when the order issued on 1976-10-25; the corrected figure then lived inside EO 11941 until EO 12010 (September 28, 1977; 42 FR 52365, section 4) provided that EO 11941 is superseded. The three held records that mention the order agree: the Federal Register catalog and the 1989 codification both note it as amending EO 11941 and superseded by EO 12010, and the U.S. Code table in the note to 5 U.S.C. 5332 lists EO 11941 as amended by EO 11943 and superseded by EO 12010. Those notes are a disposition of the amended parent and are reconciled in the savings and earlier-end checks. No held source shows a later order reviving EO 11941. The recommended provisional status is no.
savings_reason: The only consequence of EO 11943 was the corrected pay figure inside Schedule 3 of EO 11941. Section 4 of EO 12010 (42 FR 52365, official Federal Register text) supersedes EO 11941, so that consequence ended with its parent; EO 12010 states no separate effective date for section 4, so the signing date 1977-09-28 is recorded, and its new schedules took effect October 1, 1977. No payment right, appointment or transfer arose from EO 11943 itself that outlives the pay schedule, and the bounded searches of the U.S. Code, the eCFR and the Federal Register disposition catalog show no later instrument reviving EO 11941 or its Schedule 3.
earlier_end_check: No instrument earlier than EO 12010 touches EO 11943 or EO 11941 in any held source: the Federal Register catalog note, the 1989 codification line and the 5 U.S.C. 5332 note all point to EO 12010 as the superseding order, and the held-text search for the number 11943 finds only the order's own printing and the 5 U.S.C. 5332 note. The catalog note that EO 11943 is superseded by EO 12010 is read as the disposition of the amended parent: the order's own command (correct one figure) was complete on issue, 1976-10-25, which is its first end; the corrected figure survived inside EO 11941 until EO 12010 superseded that order.
scope_check: One clause only, the sole paragraph, which amends a single entry of Schedule 3 of EO 11941 (Director of Nursing Service, Section 4103 Schedule) and nothing else. The order has no other section and the held text of 41 FR 47213 is complete; there is no partial scope.
independent_command_check: No independent continuing command: the order has no duration, report, delegation or standing rule. Its single command, to change one printed figure, was exhausted on issue. The corrected figure is not a command of EO 11943 and it ended with EO 11941 when EO 12010 superseded it.
savings_check: Savings considered and none found: the correction fixes a printed pay-schedule figure for one grade in a schedule that EO 12010 superseded for later periods; no right or liability depends on EO 11943 after that, and the U.S. Code note lists the correction only as part of the superseded EO 11941.
